title: Sanctioning Iranian Regime Insiders Who Profit from Stolen Oil Wealth
summary_raw:
Thomas "Tommy" Pigott, SpokesmanOffice of the Spokesman
Press Statement


			
			


			
			
November 20, 2026
Today, the United States took action against four corrupt Iranian regime insiders who illicitly sell oil to help fund the regime’s military and its support for terrorism. Those designated include a former Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC) intelligence officer and the son of the head of Mahan Air, an airline the regime uses to move weapons and fighters for the IRGC-Qods Force.
Today’s action is part of Operation Economic Outcast, a whole-of-government campaign to cut off illicit money flows that sustain the Iranian regime. The United States will continue working to deny Tehran the revenue it uses to destabilize the region, threaten our partners, and pursue its dangerous ambitions.
Today’s designations are being taken pursuant to Executive Order (E.O.) 13902, which targets the Iranian petroleum, petrochemical, and aviation sectors, among other key sectors of the Iranian economy, and E.O. 13224, as amended, a counterterrorism authority. For more information, please see Treasury’s Press Release.

title: Joint Statement on the Sixth U.S.-Germany Joint Committee Meeting on Science and Technology Cooperation
summary_raw:
Office of the Spokesman
Media Note


			
			


			
			
November 20, 2026
The text of the following statement was released by the Governments of the United States of America and Germany.
Begin Text
The United States hosted the Federal Republic of Germany in Washington, DC, on November 19-20, 2026, for the 6th U.S.-Germany Joint Committee Meeting (JCM) on Science and Technology Cooperation. The State Department’s Assistant Secretary for European and Eurasian Affairs, Brendan Hanrahan, co-chaired the meeting with Germany’s Dr. Effrosyni Chelioti, Director General for Strategies and Policy Issues and International Affairs and Europe at the Federal Ministry of Research, Technology and Space.
The delegations used this JCM to deepen their cooperation in robotics, fusion energy, biotechnology, and critical minerals recovery. The delegations decided to promote joint research, agency-to-agency partnerships, shared technical standards where appropriate, and public-private collaboration to accelerate the path from scientific discovery to commercial application.
Both delegations reaffirmed the importance of securing the shared research ecosystem, determining to strengthen information-sharing and risk-analysis cooperation via Germany’s National Research Security Platform. The two countries underscored that protecting critical and emerging technologies is essential to safeguarding the integrity of the bilateral research relationship.
Both countries reaffirmed their commitment to a partnership that pairs German research, engineering, and manufacturing excellence with American research and commercialization strength, powering innovation that is mutually beneficial.
End Text

title: Secretary Rubio’s Call with UAE Deputy Prime Minister and Foreign Minister Sheikh Abdullah bin Zayed Al Nahyan
summary_raw:
Office of the Spokesman
Readout


			
			


			
			
November 20, 2026

Secretary of State Marco Rubio spoke today with UAE Deputy Prime Minister and Foreign Minister Sheikh Abdullah bin Zayed Al Nahyan.  The two discussed the need to end the war in Sudan, while Secretary Rubio also emphasized the importance of a humanitarian truce, durable peace, and transition to a civilian government.

title: Oman National Day
summary_raw:
Marco Rubio, Secretary of State
Press Statement


			
			


			
			
November 20, 2026
On behalf of the United States of America, I extend congratulations to His Majesty Sultan Haitham bin Tarik and to the people of the Sultanate of Oman on the occasion of your National Day.
As the United States marks 250 years of independence, we commemorate a partnership with Oman that dates back nearly as far, to the presidency of George Washington. Our relationship began with maritime trade and has expanded into energy and emerging technology. With Oman joining the Artemis Accords this year, our cooperation now extends into space exploration.
The United States values its partnership with Oman and will continue to work with the Sultanate towards regional stability. We send our best wishes for a happy National Day and continued prosperity for the Sultanate of Oman.
